steps.name: 끌기 수식키 시험 덱 zsdrag 만들기(글 e01 · 사각형 e02)
Shift 끌기 - 한 축으로만(가로가 크면 세로 0) · 격자 8 에 붙음 · 실행 취소로 제자리
steps.js: const w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const S=window.NexaStudioLink.S;const sc=()=>document.querySelector('#stage').getBoundingClientRect().width/1280;const E=(id)=>document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-id="'+id+'"]');const D=(id)=>{for(const s of S.deck.slides)for(const e of s.elements||[])if(e.id===id)return {x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};return null;};const pick=async(id)=>{const r=E(id).getBoundingClientRect();E(id).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));await w(250);};const drag=async(target,dx,dy,o)=>{const r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+Math.min(10,r.width/2),cy=r.top+Math.min(10,r.height/2);target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:cx,clientY:cy}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx/2,clientY:cy+dy/2,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy}));await w(250);};const undo=async()=>{document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click();await w(250);};await until(async()=>S.id==='zsdrag'&&E('e01'),8000);await pick('e01');const a=D('e01');await drag(E('e01'),80*sc(),30*sc(),{shiftKey:true});const b=D('e01');const ok=b.y===a.y&&b.x-a.x>=72&&b.x-a.x<=88&&(b.x-a.x)%8===0;await undo();const c=D('e01');return ok&&c.x===a.x&&c.y===a.y?true:JSON.stringify({a,b,c,sel:S.sel})

steps.name: 이미 고른 요소를 다시 끌기(그냥) - 격자 8 에 붙어 움직임 · Ctrl 끌기 - 격자·안내선 끄기(자유, x·y 모두 ±1)
steps.js: const w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const S=window.NexaStudioLink.S;const sc=()=>document.querySelector('#stage').getBoundingClientRect().width/1280;const E=(id)=>document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-id="'+id+'"]');const D=(id)=>{for(const s of S.deck.slides)for(const e of s.elements||[])if(e.id===id)return {x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};return null;};const pick=async(id)=>{const r=E(id).getBoundingClientRect();E(id).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));await w(250);};const drag=async(target,dx,dy,o)=>{const r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+Math.min(10,r.width/2),cy=r.top+Math.min(10,r.height/2);target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:cx,clientY:cy}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx/2,clientY:cy+dy/2,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy}));await w(250);};const undo=async()=>{document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click();await w(250);};await until(async()=>S.id==='zsdrag'&&E('e01'),8000);await pick('e01');const a=D('e01');await drag(E('e01'),43*sc(),21*sc());const c=D('e01');const grid=(c.x!==a.x||c.y!==a.y)&&c.x%8===0&&c.y%8===0;await undo();const d=D('e01');await drag(E('e01'),43*sc(),21*sc(),{ctrlKey:true});const b=D('e01');const free=Math.abs(b.x-a.x-43)<=1&&Math.abs(b.y-a.y-21)<=1;await undo();const e2=D('e01');return grid&&free&&d.x===a.x&&d.y===a.y&&e2.x===a.x&&e2.y===a.y?true:JSON.stringify({a,c,d,b,e2})

steps.name: 크기 - 도형 se 손잡이 Shift = 비율 유지 · 그냥 끌면 너비만(높이 그대로)
steps.js: const w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const S=window.NexaStudioLink.S;const sc=()=>document.querySelector('#stage').getBoundingClientRect().width/1280;const E=(id)=>document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-id="'+id+'"]');const D=(id)=>{for(const s of S.deck.slides)for(const e of s.elements||[])if(e.id===id)return {x:e.x,y:e.y,w:e.w,h:e.h};return null;};const pick=async(id)=>{const r=E(id).getBoundingClientRect();E(id).dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10}));await w(250);};const drag=async(target,dx,dy,o)=>{const r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=r.left+Math.min(10,r.width/2),cy=r.top+Math.min(10,r.height/2);target.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,clientX:cx,clientY:cy}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx/2,clientY:cy+dy/2,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy,...(o||{})}));await w(40);window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,clientX:cx+dx,clientY:cy+dy}));await w(250);};const undo=async()=>{document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click();await w(250);};await until(async()=>S.id==='zsdrag'&&E('e01'),8000);await pick('e02');const hd=()=>document.querySelector('#ov .hd[data-h=se]');if(!hd())return 'no handle';const a=D('e02');await drag(hd(),80*sc(),0,{shiftKey:true});const b=D('e02');const keep=b.w>a.w+40&&Math.abs(b.w/b.h-a.w/a.h)<0.06;await undo();await drag(hd(),80*sc(),0);const c=D('e02');const freeR=c.w>a.w+40&&Math.abs(c.h-a.h)<=1;await undo();const d=D('e02');return keep&&freeR&&d.w===a.w&&d.h===a.h?true:JSON.stringify({a,b,c,d})
